raw.description: 每次登场时100%令双方沉默|回合开始时，若对手处于沉默状态则当回合自身受到的固定伤害、百分比伤害减少20%，若对手不处于沉默状态则当回合对手攻击后自身恢复300点体力|战斗阶段结束时，若本回合对手使用了攻击技能则下回合攻击技能先制+1，自身未受到攻击伤害时额外+1，若本回合自身攻击技能未造成伤害，下回合攻击技能命中后附加造成伤害50%的百分比伤害|（boss无效）
raw.analyze_desc: [sprite name=dot4]每次[color=#57c975]登场时[/color]100%令双方[color=#57c975]沉默[/color]|[sprite name=dot4][color=#57c975]回合开始时[/color]，若对手处于[color=#57c975]沉默[/color]状态则[color=#52a5f2]当回合[/color]自身受到的[color=#52a5f2]固定伤害[/color]、[color=#52a5f2]百分比伤害[/color]减少20%，若对手不处于[color=#57c975]沉默[/color]状态则[color=#52a5f2]当回合[/color]对手攻击后自身恢复300点体力|[sprite name=dot4][color=#57c975]战斗阶段结束时[/color]，若本回合对手使用了攻击技能则下回合攻击[color=#52a5f2]技能先制[/color]+1，自身未受到攻击伤害时额外+1，若本回合自身攻击技能未造成伤害，下回合[color=#57c975]攻击技能命中后[/color]附加造成伤害50%的[color=#52a5f2]百分比伤害[/color]

review.reviewedBy: Codex exact source and current-field state assertions
review.rationale: 真实原生魂印2048/3088bd58：首次双方沉默及当前在场全部减伤/回复/次回强化已测；只登记来源每次登场对应的未来真实再次登场分支，不延期首次或当前效果。
review.singleBehavior: 首次双方独立100%沉默；回初快照沉默固粉减20%与独立减伤共存，敌无沉默实际攻击后魂印回300；战阶按实际敌用攻与完整红伤授次回攻击先制1或2，当前自身红伤0授次回命中附完整红伤50%粉，正红清资格、命中零红不错误补偿。

success.name: 4863真实2048入场双方分别100%沉默，公共独立时长、免异各自消费及反弹不补抽
success.assertion: test('4863真实2048入场双方分别100%沉默，公共独立时长、免异各自消费及反弹不补抽',()=>{const a=make({soul:true});for(const f of a.fighters)assert.ok([2,3].includes(f.ailments['沉默']));const b=make({soul:true,entryImmune:1});assert.equal(b.fighters[1].ailments['沉默'],undefined);assert.ok(b.fighters[0].ailments['沉默']);assert.equal(b.fighters[1].counts.immune,0);const c=make({soul:true,selfEntryImmune:1});assert.equal(c.fighters[0].ailments['沉默'],undefined);assert.ok(c.fighters[1].ailments['沉默']);assert.equal(c.fighters[0].counts.immune,0);});

success.name: 4863真实2048回初敌沉默快照减固粉20%，真伤红伤不减，中途移除沉默不撤快照
success.assertion: test('4863真实2048回初敌沉默快照减固粉20%，真伤红伤不减，中途移除沉默不撤快照',()=>{const a=native({move:10086});a.fighters[1].ailments['沉默']=3;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){delete c.a.ailments['沉默'];for(const [type,want]of[['fixed',800],['percent',800],['true',1000]]){const hp=c.t.hp;c.hurt(c.t,1000,'独立减伤状态验证',type);assert.equal(hp-c.t.hp,want);}}},()=>turn(a));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.silenceFrame2048.opponentSilent,true);});

success.name: 4863真实2048回初敌无沉默当回合实际攻击后回血300，MISS/整招无效仍用攻，控制/属性/药剂不触，技能禁疗不阻魂印
success.assertion: test('4863真实2048回初敌无沉默当回合实际攻击后回血300，MISS/整招无效仍用攻，控制/属性/药剂不触，技能禁疗不阻魂印',()=>{for(const mode of['hit','miss','blocked','control','status','potion']){const a=native({move:10086,hp:1000});timer(a,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='miss')timer(a,1,'攻击必失');if(mode==='blocked')timer(a,1,'skillBlock');if(mode==='control')a.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=3;let before,after;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='opponentAfterUse'&&c.a.side===0){if(before==null)before=c.a.hp;after=c.a.hp;}},()=>observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='opponentAfterUse'&&c.a.side===0)before=c.a.hp;},()=>turn(a,10086,mode==='status'?20117:mode==='potion'?null:10127),true));if(['hit','miss','blocked'].includes(mode))assert.equal(after-before,300);else assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,1000);}const snapshot=native({move:10086,hp:1000});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.t,'沉默',c.a,false,false,2);},()=>turn(snapshot,10086,10127));assert.equal(snapshot.fighters[0].soulState.silenceFrame2048.opponentSilent,false);assert.ok(snapshot.fighters[0].hp>1000-100);});

success.name: 4863真实2048敌实际用攻授下回合攻击先制1，未受红伤额外1；属性招不加、未行动不授、正完整伤害保1仍算受红
success.assertion: test('4863真实2048敌实际用攻授下回合攻击先制1，未受红伤额外1；属性招不加、未行动不授、正完整伤害保1仍算受红',()=>{for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=native({move:10086});if(immune)timer(s,0,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s,10086,10127);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.silenceFrame2048.nextPriority,immune?2:1);s.moveDefinitions[key(38238)].operations=[];turn(s,38238);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,3+(immune?2:1));}for(const mode of['status','control']){const s=native({move:10086});if(mode==='control')s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=2;turn(s,10086,mode==='status'?20117:10127);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.silenceFrame2048.nextPriority,0);}});

success.name: 4863真实2048本回合红伤0授仅下回合命中附完整结算红伤50%粉，MISS与已命中零红区分，正红不授
success.assertion: test('4863真实2048本回合红伤0授仅下回合命中附完整结算红伤50%粉，MISS与已命中零红区分，正红不授',()=>{const s=native({move:10086,hit:false});timer(s,0,'攻击必失');turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.silenceFrame2048.nextPercentRound,2);delete s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必失'];s.moveDefinitions[key(38238)].operations=[];turn(s,38238);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),Math.floor(sum(s)*.5));assert.ok(sum(s)>0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.silenceFrame2048.nextPercentRound,null);turn(s,38238);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),0);const a=native({move:10086});turn(a,20182);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.silenceFrame2048.nextPercentRound,2);const zero=native({move:10086});timer(zero,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(zero);assert.equal(zero.fighters[0].soulState.silenceFrame2048.nextPercentRound,2);turn(zero);assert.equal(sum(zero),0);assert.equal(sum(zero,'percent'),0);});

success.name: 4863真实2048固粉快照减伤与其他50%减伤共存，不覆盖定时效果，保1仍记录正完整红伤并仅授先制1
success.assertion: test('4863真实2048固粉快照减伤与其他50%减伤共存，不覆盖定时效果，保1仍记录正完整红伤并仅授先制1',()=>{const s=make({soul:true,move:10086});for(const f of s.fighters)f.ailments={};s.fighters[1].ailments['沉默']=3;timer(s,0,'固定百分比减伤',{fraction:.5});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){const hp=c.t.hp;c.hurt(c.t,1000,'双来源减伤','fixed');assert.equal(hp-c.t.hp,400);assert.equal(c.t.effects['固定百分比减伤'].fraction,.5);}},()=>turn(s));const a=make({soul:true,move:10086,hp:200,bStats:{atk:9999}});for(const f of a.fighters)f.ailments={};timer(a,0,'致命保留',{hp:1});turn(a,10086,10127);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,301);assert.ok(sum(a,'attack',1)>200);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.silenceFrame2048.nextPriority,1);});

success.assertion: test('4863/2203和2269仅整招无效授下次攻击免疫，伙伴2269额外清回合；零红命中不授，保护清失败不阻独立免攻',()=>{for(const r of[row(2203),row(2269)]){const s=make(r);timer(s,0,'skillBlock');timer(s,1,'priority');turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.attackNullify,1);if(r.id===2269)assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects.priority,undefined);delete s.fighters[0].effects.skillBlock;turn(s,r.move,10127);assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.attackNullify,0);const zero=make(r);timer(zero,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(zero);assert.equal(zero.fighters[0].counts.attackNullify??0,0);}const p=make(row(2269));timer(p,0,'skillBlock');timer(p,1,'priority');timer(p,1,'protect');turn(p);assert.ok(p.fighters[1].effects.priority);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].counts.attackNullify,1);});
